name: Absurd Fix
shape: Someone fixes the metric and kills the goal, then reports it proudly.
example: "The tests pass now." "How?" "I deleted the tests."

name: Shiny Object
shape: The old commitment is abandoned for something new and exciting.
example: The boss eyes the new project while the unfinished projects look on, betrayed.

name: Villain's Smile
shape: Leadership is openly pleased about the staff's loss.
example: The boss poses cheerfully at the grave of the pay raise.

name: Empty Promise
shape: The same bait works every single time.
example: Staff bite the hook labeled "Be patient, things will get better" again.

name: Ironic Inference
shape: An outsider reads a bad sign as a good sign.
example: "Your staff work 16-hour shifts." "Business must be booming!"

name: Impending Doom
shape: Disaster sneaks up on something calm and unaware.
example: The infrastructure team creeps up on the sleeping website, holding an update like a club.

name: Endless Cycle
shape: The problem that was removed walks right back in.
example: Fraud is thrown out of the company and is back at the bar in the next frame.

name: Misdirected Effort
shape: Heroic effort aimed at the wrong place achieves nothing.
example: The security team shields one side while the cyber attacks hit from the other.
